basic_info.description: Welcome to 271-273 23rd Avenue, an exceptional fixer Edwardian duplex investment opportunity nestled in the heart of San Francisco's sought-after Richmond District. Uniquely built in 1925, each of the two full-floor flats have similar layouts with approximately 1500 SF of living space, 3 bedrooms and 1 full bath including formal living rooms with fireplace, formal dining rooms with vintage period details with hardwood floors and trim, eat-in kitchen areas, built-in cabinetry, and a washer/dryer rooms.  The ground level boasts a full 2 car tandem garage with a rear storage room area with a separate side entrance to the spacious backyard of a nearly 3000 SF lot.  The possibilities are endless from adding your personal TLC touches to renovate the vacant flat to live in while generating rental income from the current tenant occupied upper flat, planning a multi-generational home, renting both flats, or expansion by adding an ADU in the enormous undeveloped basement.  Ideally located just steps from the vibrant corridors of Clement and California Streets, residents enjoy easy access to shops, restaurants, the Presidio, Golden Gate Park, and public transit. Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a classic San Francisco duplex in one of the city's most desirable neighborhoods.
